text: Figure 6.7: Multiple Transitions for Deadline Supervision in one Supervised Entity for a given Supervision Mode The configuration of DeadlineSupervision is similar to the one of AliveSupervision. The parameters of the Deadline Supervision (see DeadlineSupervision) depend on the Supervision Mode ( ModeDependentSettings) and are defined for per a set of two Checkpoints. None, some, or all of the Checkpoints of a SupervisedEntity can be configured for DeadlineSupervision in a given Mode. A DeadlineSupervision is defined as a set of T ransitions with time constraints. A T ransition is defined as two references to two Checkpoints, called Source Checkpoint and T argetCheckpoint (see DeadlineSupervision). A T ransition has minimum and maximum time MinDeadline, MaxDeadline.
